purpose: 24-hour official-source research and one-time blog topic generation

window.fallback_timestamp_policy: If no trustworthy source timestamp exists, mark timestamp_unverified=true and do not auto-publish.

reprocessing_protection.rule: After an item/event has produced a blog, its event_fingerprint remains permanently blocked unless an administrator explicitly reopens it.

sources.name: Andhra Pradesh Board of Secondary Education
Andhra Pradesh Board of Intermediate Education
Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman Diu Education
sources.scope: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

payload_schema.title: String (Required - Catchy, High-CTR, SEO-optimized title in Hinglish/English)
payload_schema.content: String (Required - Minimum 2000-2800+ words Markdown/HTML with Tables, Eligibility, Age Relaxation, 7th CPC Salary, 90-Day Strategy, Step-by-Step Guide, 10 FAQs in details/summary)
payload_schema.category: String (Required - Sarkari Jobs | Education | Admissions | Results | Schemes | Technology | Finance)
payload_schema.tags: Array of Strings (Required - e.g. ["Sarkari Result", "UP Police", "Notification 2026"])
payload_schema.featuredImage: String (Optional - High quality Unsplash/Official banner URL)
payload_schema.officialSourceUrl: String (Required - Official .gov.in/.nic.in portal URL matching one of the 315 sources)
